en.content: Two equal capacitors are first connected in series and then in parallel. The ratio of the equivalent capacities in the two cases will be :
en.explanation:
Given, C1 = C2 = C

When both capacitors are connected in series, their equivalent capacitance will be





When both capacitors are connected in parallel, their equivalent capacitance will be

Cp = C + C = 2C

The ratio of equivalent capacitance in series and parallel combination is



Cs : Cp = 1 : 4

en.content: An unpolarised light beam is incident on the polarizer of a polarization experiment and the intensity of light beam emerging from the analyzer is measured as 100 Lumens. Now, if the analyzer is rotated around the horizontal axis (direction of light) by 30<mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="0.988ex" height="1.532ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -677 436.6 677" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="msup"><g data-mml-node="mi"></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(33,363) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="2218" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2218"></use></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> in clockwise direction, the intensity of emerging light will be _________ Lumens.
en.explanation:
Given, I0 = 100 lumens

When analyser is rotated through an angle , the intensity of light will becomes

I = I0 cos2 = 100 cos230

= 100 = 75 lumens

hi.content: ध्रुवण के एक प्रयोग में किसी पोलरॉइजर पर कोई अध्रुवित प्रकाश पुंज आपतित हो रहा है। विश्लेषक से निर्गत प्रकाश पुंज की तीव्रता ल्यूमेन मापी गयी है। अब यदि विश्लेषक को क्षैतिज अक्ष (प्रकाश की दिशा) के परितः पर दक्षिणावर्त दिशा में घुमा दिया जाए तो निर्गत प्रकाश की तीव्रता _____________ ल्यूमेन होगी।

The ratio of velocities of the balls after collision is x : y, where x is __________.
en.explanation:
The situation is shown below


Using conservation of linear momentum in y-direction,

pi = pf

As, pi = 0

and pf = mv1 sin30 mv2 sin30

0 = m v1 m v2
